node.label: Elevated circulating C-triol concentration
node.definition: The concentration of cholestane-3beta, 5alpha, 6beta-triol (C-triol) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal. C-triol is a diagnostic biomarker for Niemann-Pick disease type C.
